_comment: Custom nodes + tools baked into the packaged ComfyUI at build time by scripts/prepare-comfyui.ps1. `nodes` are git-cloned (`repo`) into ComfyUI/custom_nodes/<name> or copied from the repo (`local`). `tools` are standalone processes cloned into src-tauri/resources/<name> (NOT custom_nodes) with their requirements installed into the bundled Python. `ref` optionally pins a tag/branch/commit. `pip` lists extra packages for the bundled Python.

nodes.name: comfyui-nexus-cloud
nodes.note: OUR cloud-GPU node. Provider dropdown (Modal, Beam, Cerebrium, RunPod, Vast) in the sidebar; routes /prompt to the active provider with models on a persistent volume.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-Workflow-Models-Downloader
nodes.note: Auto-detects + downloads a workflow's missing models from HF/CivitAI into the correct folder (honors extra_model_paths). HTTP API at /workflow-models/*.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
nodes.note: Official Lightricks nodes for LTX-2.3 (the latest 22B audio-video model). Required base for the LTX Director stack below.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
nodes.note: Kijai's utility nodes — a dependency of WhatDreamsCost LTX Director (and broadly useful).

nodes.name: WhatDreamsCost-ComfyUI
nodes.note: LTX Director: a full timeline editor for LTX-2.3 (first/middle/last keyframes, custom audio, Prompt Relay, t2v/i2v). Requires ComfyUI-LTXVideo + ComfyUI-KJNodes (above). Example workflows in its example_workflows/.

tools.name: comfyui-mcp-server
tools.note: Optional control layer: an MCP server (streamable-http on :9000) that wraps a running ComfyUI (:8188) and exposes generate_image / run_workflow / regenerate / job + asset tools with PARAM_* workflow templating. Standalone process, NOT a custom node. Run with: npm run comfyui:mcp.
